Warp does not support slice assignment on `wp.array` objects in the Python scope [1][2]. Attempting to perform assignments like `arr[i:] = ...` directly on `wp.array` objects from Python will fail because Warp intentionally prohibits element-wise and slice assignment at the Python scope [3][2]. This design choice is intended to avoid inefficient hidden synchronization and data transfers between host (CPU) and device (GPU) memory [1][2]. For bulk operations in the Python scope, you should use established methods such as `array.fill_()`, `array.assign()`, or `wp.copy()` [1][2].
